canonical_text_policy: Published slide titles and narration paragraphs are preserved verbatim in text; sentence-boundary chunks and slide pauses prepare the same approved narration for audio; render-only aliases live in tts_text.
pronunciation_policy: Use canonical spelling by default. Add a render-only English respelling only after a bounded same-seed test proves a concrete pronunciation error. IPA is reference metadata only.

excluded: episode status, publication, objective, learning-outcome, continuity, and discussion metadata
image paths, alt text, and visual-category metadata
source drawers and raw link destinations

chunks.text: Millions of years, no first sentence
chunks.tts_text: Millions of years, no first sentence

chunks.text: Episode 3 ended at a border with no timestamp. Now the scale changes again: we are inside millions of years of human-lineage evolution, but language itself has no reliable start date.
chunks.tts_text: Episode 3 ended at a border with no timestamp. Now the scale changes again: we are inside millions of years of human-lineage evolution, but language itself has no reliable start date.

chunks.text: Speech and gesture do not fossilize. Skulls constrain anatomy. Tools reveal complicated action sequences. Pigments, ornaments, burials, and images can show forms of symbolic behavior. None records the grammar of a vanished conversation.
chunks.tts_text: Speech and gesture do not fossilize. Skulls constrain anatomy. Tools reveal complicated action sequences. Pigments, ornaments, burials, and images can show forms of symbolic behavior. None records the grammar of a vanished conversation.

chunks.text: So do not picture a first speaker booting up language while everyone else stared. Bodies, brains, social lives, gesture, vocal control, shared attention, and cultural conventions changed across long overlapping histories.
chunks.tts_text: So do not picture a first speaker booting up language while everyone else stared. Bodies, brains, social lives, gesture, vocal control, shared attention, and cultural conventions changed across long overlapping histories.

chunks.text: The honest timeline is broad and foggy. The performance change is clearer: at some point within that history, the communication system became vastly more open-ended.
chunks.tts_text: The honest timeline is broad and foggy. The performance change is clearer: at some point within that history, the communication system became vastly more open-ended.

chunks.text: The interface was never only sound
chunks.tts_text: The interface was never only sound

chunks.text: Speech gets excellent publicity, but human language is not married to one output device.
chunks.tts_text: Speech gets excellent publicity, but human language is not married to one output device.

chunks.text: Face-to-face communication already mixes voice, hands, gaze, facial expression, posture, timing, and shared context. Signed languages show the point cleanly: they are complete natural languages with their own vocabularies and grammars, not spoken languages acted out with fingers.

chunks.text: The extraordinary system is therefore not a better throat. It is a brain-and-community capacity that can build richly structured conventions through different bodily channels.
chunks.tts_text: The extraordinary system is therefore not a better throat. It is a brain-and-community capacity that can build richly structured conventions through different bodily channels.

chunks.text: Different interface. Same larger upgrade.
chunks.tts_text: Different interface. Same larger upgrade.

chunks.text: A small kit becomes a huge address space
chunks.tts_text: A small kit becomes a huge address space

chunks.text: This is the center of the episode. Human language does not need a unique signal for every possible thought.
chunks.tts_text: This is the center of the episode. Human language does not need a unique signal for every possible thought.

chunks.text: A community learns a finite collection of contrasts, signs, words, patterns, and expectations, then recombines them. Familiar pieces can arrive in a new structure and still be understood. The practical result is open-endedness: yesterday's pieces can describe a sentence nobody has heard before.

chunks.text: In information-system language, this is compression with an exploding address space. A manageable set of reusable units can point toward an enormous range of events, objects, relationships, possibilities, and invented nonsense.
chunks.tts_text: In information-system language, this is compression with an exploding address space. A manageable set of reusable units can point toward an enormous range of events, objects, relationships, possibilities, and invented nonsense.

chunks.text: Children and communities also reshape the system as they learn and use it. Language is not a static codebook copied perfectly from one generation to the next. It is a living protocol.

chunks.text: This is the bandwidth jump the earlier episodes were approaching.
chunks.tts_text: This is the bandwidth jump the earlier episodes were approaching.

chunks.text: The present is no longer the address limit
chunks.tts_text: The present is no longer the address limit

chunks.text: Bees already show that information can point beyond the immediate scene, so humans did not invent reference to the absent. The difference is flexibility.
chunks.tts_text: Bees already show that information can point beyond the immediate scene, so humans did not invent reference to the absent. The difference is flexibility.

chunks.text: A human conversation can address yesterday, another valley, a missing person, tomorrow's river, a rule that might be changed, or an animal that has never existed. The group can compare two futures before either one happens.

chunks.text: The receiver does not download a thought intact. Meaning is reconstructed from the signal, context, memory, convention, and assumptions about the sender. Misunderstanding remains a permanent feature, not a bug we ever fully patched.
chunks.tts_text: The receiver does not download a thought intact. Meaning is reconstructed from the signal, context, memory, convention, and assumptions about the sender. Misunderstanding remains a permanent feature, not a bug we ever fully patched.

chunks.text: But the shared workspace has expanded. Bodies can remain around one fire while attention moves across time, distance, and imagination.
chunks.tts_text: But the shared workspace has expanded. Bodies can remain around one fire while attention moves across time, distance, and imagination.

chunks.text: A learner can debug the hidden step
chunks.tts_text: A learner can debug the hidden step

chunks.text: Stone tools remind us why higher message capacity matters. Toolmaking existed millions of years ago, long before we can responsibly date language, and observation, practice, gesture, and simpler communication could transmit skill.

chunks.text: Once language is available, teaching gains another channel. An expert can direct attention to the hidden variable: this edge, not that one; strike here; the angle changed; try again.
chunks.tts_text: Once language is available, teaching gains another channel. An expert can direct attention to the hidden variable: this edge, not that one; strike here; the angle changed; try again.

chunks.text: Experiments with modern learners show that gestural and verbal teaching can improve stone-knapping transmission. They do not date prehistoric language. They show what explanation can add to demonstration.

chunks.text: Information about error and cause can now travel beside the action. The learner does not have to reverse-engineer every mistake alone.
chunks.tts_text: Information about error and cause can now travel beside the action. The learner does not have to reverse-engineer every mistake alone.

chunks.text: Many minds can edit the same future
chunks.tts_text: Many minds can edit the same future

chunks.text: Animals coordinate without human language. Human cooperation did not begin here.
chunks.tts_text: Animals coordinate without human language. Human cooperation did not begin here.

chunks.text: What language expands is the shared model. One person proposes a route. Another recalls a flood. Someone objects, assigns a role, changes a rule, promises an action, or explains why the plan will fail before everyone discovers the failure together.

chunks.text: In system terms, the group has something like a temporary shared workspace with multiple readers and writers. It is noisy, political, emotional, and very unlike a clean database — but alternatives can be compared and revised before action.

chunks.text: Language is one amplifier inside a larger cultural system of imitation, teaching, trust, institutions, tools, population connections, and long childhoods. It is powerful without being the sole engine.

chunks.text: The archive can last generations — but it still breathes
chunks.tts_text: The archive can last generations — but it still breathes

chunks.text: A spoken sound may last seconds. A signed movement may vanish almost as quickly. Yet oral traditions can keep complex knowledge alive across generations because people repeatedly remember, perform, teach, correct, and adapt it.
chunks.tts_text: A spoken sound may last seconds. A signed movement may vanish almost as quickly. Yet oral traditions can keep complex knowledge alive across generations because people repeatedly remember, perform, teach, correct, and adapt it.

chunks.text: That is a remarkable storage extension. Stories, songs, ceremonies, specialists, landmarks, and repeated practices can distribute knowledge across a community instead of leaving it inside one memory.
chunks.tts_text: That is a remarkable storage extension. Stories, songs, ceremonies, specialists, landmarks, and repeated practices can distribute knowledge across a community instead of leaving it inside one memory.

chunks.text: But the medium still requires active readers and writers. If transmission chains break, parts of the archive can disappear. Oral systems are not failed writing systems; they are powerful living storage with different durability and failure modes.

chunks.text: After billions of years of biological storage, hundreds of millions of years of nervous systems, and generations of social and oral memory, the next pressure is almost embarrassingly obvious: can information wait in the world without a living mind continuously carrying it?
